name: Crate of Crash Helmets
label: Item
description: A heavy supply shipment of dwarven Siege Engine headgear destined for the Shimmering Flats in Thousand Needles. The sturdy helmets are urgently required…
intro: A heavy supply shipment of dwarven Siege Engine headgear destined for the Shimmering Flats in Thousand Needles. The sturdy helmets are urgently required by the Brassbolts brothers to protect test drivers from concussions caused by their experimental rocket cars.

p: Out across the blinding white expanse of the Shimmering Flats, gnome engineers test the absolute limits of mechanical propulsion. Unfortunately for the test pilots, the experimental rocket cars designed by the Brassbolts brothers move far faster than their steering can reliably handle. With drivers routinely suffering violent crashes and head trauma, ordinary leather caps no longer suffice. To prevent their roster of willing daredevils from vanishing entirely, heavy-duty dwarven Siege Engine helmets are packed and dispatched across the sea to keep drivers conscious—and alive.
